description:

They skyrocketed to worldwide stardom 60 years ago with No1 hit Sherry – so, come out tonight as we celebrate all of their million-selling hits.

Walk Like a Man, Rag Doll, Oh What a Night, Silence is Golden. . . in one incredible concert show! Time to hang on to what you got. . . 7.30pm – it’s the time, Stirling – it’s the place, Albert Halls it’s the motion.

So, come out tonight as we take you to a place where the moon shines bright and we dance the night away, taking you back in time with Big Girls Don’t Cry, celebrating the iconic sounds of Frankie Valli & The Four Seasons.

This non-stop hit machine, authentically recreated by our phenomenal cast and live band will transport you back in time to 1963 and beyond for a magical evening enjoying all your favourites.

During the 60s and 70s No1 hits Sherry, December 1963 (Oh What a Night), Walk Like a Man, Rag Doll and Big Girls Don’t Cry helped propel the Four Seasons and Frankie Valli to super stardom.

After selling an incredible 100 million records worldwide, there’s a Four Seasons song that shares a special place in everyone’s heart. This internationally acclaimed show authentically revives the sublime harmonies of New Jersey’s finest.

It showcases Frankie’s incredible falsetto, and features his solo hits like Grease, Let’s Hang On, Working My Way Back to You, Beggin’, I’ve Got You Under My Skin, and Who Loves You.

So it’s time to hang on to what we got and celebrate one of the world’s treasures in two hours of non-stop hits with Big Girls Don’t Cry!

Oh what a night it will be! It’s the time, it’s the place, it’s the motion.

This is a tribute show and is no way affiliated with any original artists/estates/management companies or similar shows.

description:
Gary Meikle returns to the stage with another new show which has quickly become the yearly norm for him now.

Hi guys it’s me, Gary. These blurbs do my head in if I’m honest, each year I need to sit and write one out before I even know what stories I’m gonna share, well I mean I don’t have to write one I could pay something else to do it but f that they’d just write some mundane vague crap which I can clearly do myself. At least this way you know I’ve written it personally. So what’s the new show about? Again, I don’t yet, but it will contain at least one ‘yer maw’ Joke, what I do know is that it’ll be another brand new 80-90 minutes of stories, opinions and observations about me, and my family as well as you all its always about people and the mad shit we do, sometimes animals but more often than not it’s about people and the stupid scenarios we end up in. I wonder if that’s now enough wordage to cover the minimum blurb requirement? I guess we’ll see, and I’ll see you all soon maybe – oh, one last thing, my show isn’t suitable for small people, some of it might be about them, in fact it definitely will but, yeah they ain’t getting in 🙂

Overview

“We’re over the moon to be back at Winterlight Festival! Stirling audiences are always up for a great time, and the Albert Halls never fails to feel special. The days after Christmas are always crying out for a bit of fun and what better excuse to get together, sing your heart out and let your hair down before Hogmanay”

For over 15 years, Mànran has been at the heart of the Scottish traditional music scene, earning a reputation as a multi-award-winning powerhouse. Known for their bold fusion of traditional and contemporary influences, the seven-piece band continues to captivate audiences worldwide with their distinctive sound and high-energy performances.

Seamlessly combining English and Gaelic songs, with a dynamic mix of bagpipes, fiddle, accordion, whistle, and flute—alongside guitars, drums, and bass—Mànran creates music that is deeply rooted in tradition yet constantly evolving. Their original compositions, crafted with skill and expertise, showcase the band’s ability to push musical boundaries while staying true to their heritage.

With performances in over 30 countries, Mànran has built a loyal global following, further solidified by their win as ‘International Artist of the Year’ at the Australian Celtic Music Awards. Whether playing major festival stages or intimate venues, their live shows are a testament to their connection with audiences and their commitment to musical excellence.

As they continue to explore new musical territory, Mànran remains one of Scotland’s most iconic and respected bands, forging a path that celebrates tradition while embracing the future.

Tolbooth & The Albert Halls present Stirling Mini Melodies. FREE weekly sessions for pre-school children and carers, promoting early musical engagement and social connection.

Looking for a joyful Friday morning activity for you and your little one? Welcome to Stirling Mini Melodies, a warm, inclusive weekly music group for babies, toddlers and their parents and carers.

Music is a magic ingredient for early years development. Engaging with rhythm and melody helps little ones build essential language skills, boosts physical coordination, and supports emotional confidence—all while having a wonderful time.

  • Sensory-rich play: We explore music through singing, movement, and simple instruments to spark brain development and sensory curiosity.
  • Get involved: These aren’t passive classes. We invite parents and carers to join the fun, creating a special bond through a shared creative experience.
  • Accessible and fun: Our group is informal and inclusive, ensuring every family in Stirling can feel at home and join the rhythm.
  • A warm welcome: Because we know how much a caffeine boost helps, we provide free tea and coffee for the grown-ups after class. A great way to relax and meet other parents!
  • Completely free: This class is part of our Stirling Sounds project and is funded by the Youth Music Initiative, meaning there are no financial barriers to joining.

**Dates:** Fri 21st Aug to Fri 9th Oct

Get ready for an unforgettable night as The Scottish Pink Floyd, Scotland’s premier Pink Floyd tribute band, brings their Greatest Hits spectacular to town in 2026! This sensational 11 piece ensemble delivers two and a half hours of expertly crafted renditions of all the classics—from The Dark Side of the Moon, Wish You Were Here, and The Wall, to The Division Bell, and more.

Expect a full immersive experience of sonic excellence and visual flair: dazzling light shows, laser projections, cinema quality visuals, and authentic sound effects all work in perfect harmony to recreate the vibe of a true Pink Floyd concert. With decades of commitment to faithful performances and a deep passion for the Floyd legacy, this is a show that even the most devoted fans will applaud.

Their Greatest Hits show is ideal both for long time Floyd lovers and newcomers ready to discover the drama and beauty of this legendary music. Whether you’re dancing, singing along, or simply soaking it in, it’s an electric evening guaranteed to deliver goosebumps.

Don’t miss your chance to catch The Scottish Pink Floyd live in town in 2026—an unforgettable tribute to one of rock’s greatest bands.

title: Tide Lines
description:
Tide Lines

Wednesday 25th November 2026

Tide Lines have taken their 10 year celebrations all around Europe and spent the summer playing festivals across the UK. But there are still a few parts of Scotland they've missed on their travels this year…So they're hitting the road again!

Limited Tickets

The Albert Halls - Seating and Standing

Date: Wednesday 25th November 2026

Door Times: 7pm

Tickets: £32.00 – £37.00

10 YEARS OF TIDE LINES!

Tide Lines have taken their 10 year celebrations all around Europe and spent the summer playing festivals across the UK. But there are still a few parts of Scotland they’ve missed on their travels this year… So they’re hitting the road again!

Tide Lines are returning to The Albert Halls, Stirling, this November with their good friend Calum Bowie opening the show – we can’t wait to welcome them back!

Tide Lines are a band whose story stretches from the wild expanses of the Scottish Highlands to the beating heart of Glasgow. In June 2025, they celebrated a landmark moment with their fourth album Glasgow Love Story via their own Tide Lines Music label, which landed at No.1 in Scotland and No.11 in the UK Official Album Charts — their highest UK chart position to date and third Scottish No.1.

Now, as they mark 10 years together, the story continues with the recently released Glasgow Love Story, an album rooted not in island remoteness but in the pulse of the city they now call home.

With special guest Calum Bowie

title: We Three Kings of Country
description:
We Three Kings of Country

The Music of Johnny Cash, Hank Williams & Jim Reeves From the producers of We Three Kings – of Rock n Roll

The Albert Halls - Seated

Date: Thursday 12th November 2026

Door Times: 7pm

Tickets: £23.20

Overview

The Music of Johnny Cash, Hank Williams & Jim Reeves

From the producers of We Three Kings – of Rock n Roll

Johnny Cash Performed by Dave Bogle, engages with the audience, classic songs ‘Folsom Prison Blues’, ‘Ghost Riders in the Sky’ & ‘A Boy named Sue’ and there is plenty more where they came from!

Multi talented Dave Bogle, has performed everywhere from the ‘West End’ to ‘Nashville’, playing various roles in various shows. Today, Dave performs and celebrates the music of one of his heroes, Johnny Cash. Marc Robinson renowned for playing Buddy Holly all over Great Britain has a love for Hank Williams that can be seen in his performance as he sings ‘I Saw the Light’, ‘Take these Chains’ & ‘Howlin at the Moon’.

Lee Davidge, one of the founders of the Rock n Roll group Red Alert sensitively plays the ballads of Jim Reeves (known as Gentleman Jim). Dressed in his authentic costume, this is an evening to sit back, relax, and sing along to the timeless classics ‘Welcome to my World’, ‘I Love you Because’, & of course the happy sound of ‘Bimbo’!

Suits all ages as long as you’re prepared for a classic Country Music Evening!

Pure Country Magic!
